title: Network
items: On which ports do outbound connections such as email, SNMP, syslog, and NTP operate?
Only on ports configured with a system management IP address
Email、SNMP、Syslog、NTP 等對外連線只在設有系統管理 IP 的 Port 上運作。
簡報 S3、S4；Concept Guide Ch16 Routing considerations
If the destination of an outbound connection is in the same subnet as a management IP, how is it sent?
Directly from the matching Ethernet port
Through the default gateway of the lowest port
目的地與管理 IP 同子網路時，直接由相符的 Ethernet Port 送出。
If the destination is not in the same subnet as any management IP, which port is used?
The lowest-numbered port with a management IP, through its default gateway
The port with the most bandwidth
否則送往 Default Gateway，取編號最低且設有管理 IP 的 Port。
Is VLAN tagging enabled by default?
VLAN 提供 Layer 2 流量 Isolation，預設不啟用。
簡報 S4；Concept Guide Ch16 Configuring VLAN
Which CLI option sets a VLAN ID for an IP address?
以 CLI 的 `mkip -vlan` 設定 VLAN ID。
How should VLAN IDs be configured on the two nodes of an I/O group?
The local and failover ports should use the same VLAN ID
Each node must use a different VLAN
Only one node needs a VLAN
VLANs are not supported on I/O groups
I/O Group 兩個 Node 的本機與 Failover Port 應設相同 VLAN ID；iSCSI Host 連線也須對稱。
Which VLAN configuration is NOT supported?
同一子網路但不同 VLAN 不受支援；變更 VLAN 會中斷該 Port 流量。
How many system IP addresses can be configured?
Up to 2, IPv4, IPv6, or mixed
最多 2 個系統位址，可為 IPv4、IPv6 或混合。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch16 System IP addresses
What is required for system IP addresses to fail over to any node?
They must be on ports in the same subnet
They must be on FC ports
系統 IP 必須位於同一子網路的 Port，才能 Failover 到任一 Node。
Can management and service IP addresses be used for host I/O?
管理與 Service IP 不可用於 Host I/O。
What happens to a failed node's port IP addresses?
The partner node takes them over (node-port IP failover)
They are lost until the node returns
They move to the configuration node only
Node 失效時其 Port IP 由 Partner Node 接手，即 Node-port IP Failover。
How many storage portsets exist on the system?
Storage Portset 只有一個，為 Portset 3。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch16 Requirements for storage portsets
What does Priority Flow Control (PFC) do?
Pauses or slows specific traffic classes during congestion to protect important traffic
PFC 在擁塞時暫停或減速特定流量類別，以保護重要流量。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch16 Priority flow control
Which three traffic classes can PFC be configured for?
PFC 有 System、Host Attachment 與 Storage (Virtualization) 三種流量類別。
What is the range of PFC priority tags?
Priority Tag 為 0 至 7，各類別可設相同或不同。
What is a prerequisite for using PFC?
VLAN 是使用 PFC 的前提，且需端到端設定。
When multiple traffic types share a port with PFC, what must also be configured?
同一 Port 共用多種流量時須設定 Enhanced Transmission Selection (ETS)。
Which minimum Brocade Fabric OS version is required for auto zoning?
Auto Zoning 需 Brocade Fabric OS 9.1.1 以上，並在 Storage Target Port 啟用 TDZ。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch16 Auto zoning
What does FDMI registration provide to the fabric?
Node name, port speed, and software version
FDMI 註冊讓系統向 Fabric 提供 Node 名稱、Port 速度與軟體版本。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch16 FDMI
All devices on the fabric, including unzoned devices
FDMI 探索可查詢 Fabric 上所有裝置，包含未 Zone 的裝置。
From what is an FC port WWPN derived?
FC Port 以實體 Port 編號與 WWPN 識別，WWPN 由 Node 的 WWNN 衍生。
Which command shows FC port details including speed?
Port 速度與 Switch 或 Host 自動協商，可由 Monitoring > System、Service Assistant 或 `lsportfc` 查看。
In large configurations with more than 64 host objects
超過 64 個 Host Object 的大型 Configuration 須使用 Single-initiator Zoning。
What does N_Port ID Virtualization (NPIV) allow?
A physical FC port to log in to the fabric with multiple WWPNs and WWNNs
NPIV 讓一個實體 FC Port 以多組 WWPN 與 WWNN 登入 Fabric，Host I/O 與 Cluster 通訊使用不同 WWPN。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch16 N-Port ID Virtualization
What is a benefit of NPIV for host multipathing?
Path failures caused by an offline node are hidden from host multipathing
It removes the need for zoning
Node 離線造成的路徑失效會對 Host Multipathing 隱藏，Host I/O WWPN 準備好才上線。
If NPIV zoning rules are not followed, what can happen during I/O group transitions?
An I/O pause of about 2 minutes
未遵守 Zoning 規則時，I/O Group 轉換期間可能出現約 2 分鐘 I/O 暫停。
What does FC port masking control?
Which ports are used for node-to-node or partner system communication
FC Port Masking 控制 Port 用於 Node 間或 Partner 系統通訊，不影響 Host 與儲存流量。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch16 Fibre Channel port masking
In a port mask, which position represents port 1?
Port Mask 為位元字串，最右邊為 Port 1，1 表示啟用、0 表示停用。
With 8 ports, a local port mask of 00001100 allows which ports to communicate with other nodes?
由右往左數，第 3 與第 4 位元為 1，因此 Port 3、4 可與其他 Node 連線。
Which mask controls communication with remote partner systems?
Local Port Mask 管本系統內 Node 間通訊，Partner Port Mask 管與遠端 Partner 的通訊。
What is the minimum fabric redundancy recommendation for SAN configuration?
At least two independent switches or switch networks
至少使用兩個獨立 Switch 或 Switch 網路以確保 Fabric 冗餘；單一 Fabric 有效但有單點失效風險。
Why should fabrics be kept separate?
Merging them can increase the number of paths to volumes
It is required for NPIV only
各 Fabric 應保持分離，合併可能增加 Volume 路徑；最多支援 8 條路徑。
How many FC ports per node should connect to the SAN at minimum?
每個 Node 至少要有兩個 FC Port 連到 SAN。
How must back-end storage systems be connected?
所有 Back-end 儲存系統一律只連 SAN Switch。
During FC link failure troubleshooting, what should you try first?
Ensure the cable is seated at both ends
依序嘗試：確認 Cable 兩端插好、更換 Cable、更換 SFP、依 Switch 程序處理，最後才更換 FC Adapter。
What is required when replacing an SFP?
Replace it with the same type; longwave and shortwave cannot be mixed
Any SFP type can be used
SFP 必須以相同類型更換，長波與短波不可混用；拆錯 SFP 可能造成資料無法存取。
Which command checks Rx and Tx power and error counts on FC ports?
用 `lsportstats` 確認 Rx、Tx Power 高於低警報門檻，一小時後再確認錯誤計數是否停止增加。
Hosts or remote devices to communicate only through the ports and addresses in the portset
Portset 是系統範圍物件，限制 Host 或遠端裝置只能經由 Portset 內的 Port 與位址通訊。
Which command creates an FC replication portset?
`mkportset -type replication -porttype fc` 建立 FC Replication Portset。
Which portset usage hint is used for HA and synchronous replication?
Usage Hint：short_distance 用於 HA 與同步，long_distance 用於長距離 DR。
How many portsets of each usage hint are allowed in a system?
每種 Usage Hint 在系統內僅允許一個 Portset。
Why configure an internal proxy server?
So Call Home and Support Assistance can reach the Support Center without opening outbound firewall ports
可指定 Internal Proxy，讓 Call Home 與 Support Assistance 連到 Support Center，不必在防火牆開放對外 Port。
簡報 S10；Concept Guide Ch16 HTTP proxy server
Where is the internal proxy server configured in the GUI?
GUI 路徑為 Settings > Network > Internal Proxy Server，且需 DNS Server 解析名稱。
With how many remote systems can a system form partnerships?
一個系統最多可與 3 個遠端系統建立 Partnership。
Which ports carry management traffic for partnerships and must be on the default management IP?
管理流量使用 6443、7443 與 443 Port，須位於預設管理 IP。
What must be true about system layers to create a partnership?
Both systems must be in the same layer
They must be in different layers
兩個系統必須在相同 Layer 才能建立 Partnership；SVC 一律為 Replication Layer，FlashSystem 預設為 Replication Layer。
Which status should lspartnership show for a validated IP partnership?
在每個系統執行 `lspartnership`，確認狀態為 Fully Configured。
Which ports do not support IP replication?
100g Port 不支援 IP Replication；系統最多支援 3 個 IP Partnership。
What does the partnership status not_present indicate?
The remote system cannot be seen due to connectivity, availability, or configuration issues
not_present 表示看不到遠端系統，可能是連線問題、遠端不可用或設定錯誤，例如雙方 Portset IP 不可達。
Which is a common cause of mkippartnership failure?
The system has too many hosts
Portset 為空時須先設定 IP 並對應到 Portset；另外兩邊要同時指定 link1 或 link2。
